title: 第5章 炼药第6章 大妖功
content_zh:
石墩前，张楚双手抱住了三百斤的石墩，腰部发力，直接把它抱了起来！
虽然吃力，但比以前可强太多了。
要知道，之前张楚连一百五十斤的石墩都抱不动！
张楚顿时狂喜：“我明白了，吃妖宝，可以让山海图产生某种进化，然后，山海图会反馈给我一定的力量！”
当然，三百斤的力气，绝对不是张楚的极限。
因为，此刻的山海图，在源源不断的散发着那种神秘力量，不断滋养张楚的肉身。
张楚感觉，假以时日，自己的力气，没准可以比得上童青山！
紧接着，张楚想到了这山海图的来源。
当初，张楚坐在家里的老枣树下读书的时候，读就是一本古《山海经》，但穿越过来之后，那本书就不见了。
看来，它一直藏在自己体内。
不过，吃妖宝才能得到好处，还是有点过于奢侈了。
妖，哪里那么容易杀？
如果不是老枣树，整个小山村的人，恐怕都要死了。
但很快，张楚又心中释然：
“想想也是，山海经，本就是一本吃货图志，里面无论描述什么，都会加一句‘食之如何如何’，那么这幅山海图在我体内，鼓动着我吃妖，倒也说的过去。”
张楚得到了山海图，心中高兴，但并没有表露的太明显。
被小村里的人尊称了三年先生，张楚自然养成了一种喜怒不形于色的沉稳气度。
很快，张楚不再关注山海图，而是指点着众人开始处理兔妖和狐妖的尸体。
大妖的妖宝，孩子们和村民不能服用，但大妖的肉，也是难得的宝药。
大妖的皮毛，也可以做成护具，让猎人队在外狩猎的时候，更加安全。

“芸婶，你的手艺好，兔妖的皮毛和狐狸的皮毛，就交给你了，小心鞣制，给青山他们做几身好皮甲。”
“好嘞，你就放心吧！”芸婶答应道。
至于肉……
这时候张楚看向了不远处，发现几个年轻人生了一堆火，他们串了一些兔肉，正在烧烤。
张楚见状，顿时提醒道：“青雷，小心点，这妖肉可不简单。”
童青雷只有16岁，虽然是个毛头小子，但却已经加入了猎人队。
此刻，童青雷嘿嘿笑：“先生，放心好了，活的妖咱们打不过，它的肉，总不至于还吃不掉。”
这话刚说完，那串成串的兔妖肉，突然就炸了。
轰！
巨大的声音，让所有人耳朵一阵失聪。
那一堆火更是被炸开，四处都是火星。
“发生了什么？”有人惊呼。
“哎呀我去！”
“好疼！”
童青雷等几个毛头小伙子惨叫，他们靠得近，脸上被炸的黑漆漆，好像刚从炭火里扒拉出来一样。
几个小孩子见状，顿时笑的前仰后合：“哈哈哈，黑猴子，黑猴子！”
“青雷叔叔变成黑炭喽！哈哈哈……”
几个调皮的孩子，甚至围着童青雷转圈。
content_en:
In front of the stone pier, Zhang Chu hugged the 300-pound stone pier with both hands, exerted force on his waist, and picked it up directly!
Although it is difficult, it is much better than before.
You know, Zhang Chu couldn't even lift a stone pier of 150 kilograms before!
Zhang Chu was immediately ecstatic: "I understand. Eating demon treasures can make the Mountains and Seas Map evolve in some way. Then, the Mountains and Seas Map will feed back a certain amount of power to me!"
Of course, three hundred kilograms of strength is definitely not Zhang Chu's limit.
Because, the mountain and sea map at this moment is constantly exuding that mysterious power, constantly nourishing Zhang Chu's body.
Zhang Chu felt that given time, his strength might be comparable to Tong Qingshan!
Immediately afterwards, Zhang Chu thought of the origin of this mountain and sea map.
At the beginning, when Zhang Chu was sitting under the old jujube tree at home and reading, he was reading an ancient book called "The Classic of Mountains and Seas", but after traveling through time, that book disappeared.
It seems that it has been hidden in his body.
However, it is still a bit too extravagant to get benefits from eating monster treasures.
Demon, how can it be so easy to kill?
If it weren't for the old jujube tree, the entire village would probably be dead.
But soon, Zhang Chu felt relieved again:
"Think about it. The Classic of Mountains and Seas is originally a foodie's illustrated journal. No matter what is described in it, it will always add the sentence "how to eat." So this picture of mountains and seas is in my body, encouraging me to eat monsters, which makes sense."
Zhang Chu got the map of mountains and seas and was happy, but he didn't show it too obviously.
Being honored as "Mr. Three Years" by the people in the small village, Zhang Chu naturally developed a calm demeanor that showed no emotion or anger.
Soon, Zhang Chu no longer paid attention to the mountain and sea map, but directed everyone to start processing the bodies of the rabbit demon and fox demon.
Children and villagers cannot take the monster treasure of the big monster, but the meat of the big monster is also a rare treasure.
The fur of the big demon can also be made into protective gear, making the hunter team safer when hunting.
"Aunt Yun, your craftsmanship is good. I will leave the rabbit fur and fox fur to you. Carefully tan them and make some good leather armors for Qingshan and the others."
"Okay, don't worry!" Aunt Yun agreed.
As for the meat…
At this time, Zhang Chu looked not far away and found that a few young people had made a fire. They had skewered some rabbit meat and were grilling it.
Seeing this, Zhang Chu immediately reminded: "Qing Lei, be careful, this monster meat is not simple."
Tong Qinglei is only 16 years old. Although he is a young boy, he has already joined the hunter team.
At this moment, Tong Qinglei chuckled: "Sir, don't worry, we can't defeat the living demon, but we can't eat its meat."
As soon as he said this, the skewers of rabbit meat suddenly exploded.
boom!
The huge sound made everyone deaf.
The fire was even exploded, with sparks everywhere.
"What happened?" someone exclaimed.
"Oh, I'll go!"
"It hurts!"
Tong Qinglei and several other young men screamed in agony. They got closer, their faces were blown black, as if they had just been pulled out of the charcoal fire.
When several children saw this, they burst out laughing: "Hahaha, black monkey, black monkey!"
"Uncle Qing Lei has turned into black coal! Hahaha..."
A few naughty children even circled around Tong Qinglei.
